pages.lesson:
LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 2.3.1 NOUNS AND QUANTIFIERS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Nouns and Quantifiers

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Nouns and Quantifiers. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How do count nouns differ from the non- count nouns?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Nouns and Quantifiers
2. Practise Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Nouns and Quantifiers at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Nouns and Quantifiers

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Nouns and Quantifiers
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Nouns and Quantifiers. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Nouns and Quantifiers at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Nouns and Quantifiers at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Nouns and Quantifiers
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Nouns and Quantifiers. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Nouns and Quantifiers using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Nouns and Quantifiers in the examples.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Nouns and Quantifiers to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Nouns and Quantifiers.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Nouns and Quantifiers using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Nouns and Quantifiers important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read a short passage in which quantifiers are used to describe count and non-count nouns,
2. Listen to a text that uses quantifiers with count and non- count nouns,
3. Unity: It is fostered as the learner collaborates with others to identify count and non-count nouns in small groups.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do count nouns differ from the non- count nouns?
2. Why is it important to express the quantity of something correctly?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Nouns and Quantifiers
2. Practise Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Nouns and Quantifiers at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Nouns and Quantifiers

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
